blindSourceSummaries: A public broadcaster (9 Aug 2024): the killing of a well-known trans social-media figure (about 10,000 followers) found beaten beside a capital-city highway hours after posting that she was going out; she had been stabbed in Sept 2023 and had expressed fear for her life; police opened a 'thorough and discreet' investigation. The report notes mass arrests and detention of LGBT+ locals are common, especially in some states.

An independent queer-culture magazine: reporting on the scene in the federal capital - threats and police raids alongside informal community organising, and community grief after the murder of a well-known trans social-media figure (Aug 2024).

A news outlet (19 Aug 2026): a foreign government's updated travel advice warns LGBT+ travellers to this country of arrest, violence, attacks, blackmail and intimidation - same-sex conduct carries up to 14 years, some states apply religious-law provisions that can prescribe the death penalty, and the law penalises those who help arrange or attend such weddings.
